acceptance.requirement: An immutable dispatch-request.v1 binds run, node, attempt, stage profile, prompt, DAG/frontier, repository, base/candidate, test contract, epoch, path policy, Skills, and explicit group/member identities.
Effective model, effort, role, sandbox, fork, cwd, prompt, base/candidate, Skills, and request identity are derived from runtime or machine observations and fail closed when missing.
Requested and effective stage identities match exactly; context, sandbox, cwd, prompt, source, base, candidate, epoch, and test contract drift reject the receipt.
candidateDigest is independently observed from the machine git identity and must exactly match the sealed request; matching candidateSha cannot mask a digest drift.
Root is Sol/low, code implementers are Sol/low, test owners are Sol/max with writes restricted to owned tests/fixtures, and read-only verifier profiles cannot acquire write access.
A read-only reviewer stage cannot request workspace-write or a write lease; invalid reviewer policy is rejected while sealing the request even when runtime would exactly match the invalid request.
Required and actually loaded Skill IDs and digests come from machine load evidence; UI stages fail closed on missing or drifted loads.
Request, attempt, thread, rollout, runtime metadata, receipt, candidate, and epoch identities are unique and replay resistant.
Group/session/member/stage/write-lease/worktree/branch/continuity identities match runtime observations; one lease cannot serve multiple members and non-group dispatch is explicit null.

implementer-self-test-receipt.v1 binds the same request/base/candidate/contract, the full visible matrix, unchanged frozen test tree, implementation diff, command exits, lint/typecheck/build policy, failures, cycles, and working tree.
Only a verified dispatch starts work and only a verified self-test admits candidate-green; self-test never substitutes for fresh independent behavior verification.
Requests, observations, and receipts contain digests and allowlisted metadata only, never prompts, tokens, credentials, or secret environment.
Executable runtime probes cover real rollout-shaped metadata, a fresh behavior verifier, and the verify-runtime CLI; absent CLI inputs reject with nonzero status and a diagnostic.

The test-owner request profile is fixed to Sol/max with workspace-write limited by the test-owner scoped lease; a self-consistent Terra/low/danger-full-access/unrestricted request is rejected during sealing.
A non-root DAG creator/updater is fixed to Sol/max/read-only and cannot seal a self-consistent Terra/low/workspace-write request.
RepositoryA UI implementation dispatch requires the frozen design Skills and nonempty matching design-authority digests; an empty self-consistent declaration is rejected during sealing.
Credential-bearing rollout or machine observations reject the dispatch and secret values are absent from runtime observations and returned receipts.
Every frozen test contract requires a verified dispatch before implementation starts; enforcement cannot depend on one issue-specific test path appearing in frozenFiles.
Every frozen test contract requires implementer-self-test-receipt.v1 for candidate-green; omitting one issue-specific test path cannot restore legacy verified-candidate receipts.
The self-test receipt digest binds implementationDiffDigest, every command result evidence digest, and first-failure/fix-cycle evidence so distinct executions cannot collide.

Self-test verification requires a complete digest-valid dispatch receipt bound to the same request, attempt, epoch, thread, rollout, and runtime evidence; a minimal forged verified object has no authority.
